serverInfo.title: Trade It
serverInfo.description: Connect an agent to the user's brokerage accounts across Charles Schwab, Coinbase, ETrade, Kraken, Moomoo, Public, Robinhood, Tastytrade, TradeStation, TradeStation Paper, Webull: read accounts, holdings, and trade history, look up assets, draft stock, crypto, and options orders for review, execute or cancel orders, and create shareable trade links.
